claim_or_result: First-person self-knowledge and prereflective self-consciousness are established objects of philosophical analysis.
verification_scope: Check whether established philosophical reference material treats self-knowledge and prereflective self-consciousness as subjects of philosophical analysis.
verification_method: Independent cross-check against Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy entries on self-knowledge and self-consciousness, including prereflective self-awareness.
limitations: The result verifies that these concepts are established subjects of philosophical analysis; it does not settle disputed philosophical theories about their nature.
